headline: Frequent Rework of Cell Width Calculation Logic
diagnosis: The file rich/cells.py is undergoing frequent rework primarily due to issues related to character cell width calculations, as indicated by the recurring themes in commit messages such as 'fix for infinite loop in split_graphemes', 'Fix ZWJ and edge cases', and 'more defensive condition'. The complexity of handling various Unicode characters and edge cases is leading to multiple fixes and refinements.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the character cell width calculation logic, focusing on the get_character_cell_size function and its handling of edge cases.
Implement comprehensive unit tests that cover all Unicode ranges and edge cases mentioned in the commit messages to ensure robustness.
Refactor the code to simplify the logic where possible, especially in areas identified as problematic in recent commits.
Establish a code review process specifically for changes to this file to ensure that any modifications are scrutinized for potential impacts on functionality.
owner_hint: Assign ownership to a single developer to reduce bus factor.
